column8: ∀ {ids : Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.CellIds} {raw : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId}, ids.order.toList = raw.eraseDups → (∀ (id : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId), ids.seen.contains id = Bool.true ↔ id ∈ raw) → ids.Exact raw
∀ {ids : Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.CellIds} {raw : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId}, ids.Exact raw → ids.order.toList = raw.eraseDups

∀ {ids : Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.CellIds} {raw : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId}, ids.Exact raw → ∀ (id : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId), ids.seen.contains id = Bool.true ↔ id ∈ raw

∀ {ids : Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.CellIds} {raw : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId}, ids.Exact raw → ∀ (more : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId), (ids.addAll more).Exact (raw ++ more)

∀ {ids : Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.CellIds} {image : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.Image}, ids.Exact (Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.rawIds image) → ∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord), (ids.admit record).Exact (Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.rawIds { seed := image.seed, accepted := image.accepted ++ [record] })

∀ {ids : Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.CellIds} {image : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.Image}, ids.Exact (Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.rawIds image) → ∀ (id : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId), ids.seen.contains id = Bool.true ↔ id ∈ image.cellIds
∀ {ids : Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.CellIds} {image : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.Image}, ids.Exact (Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.rawIds image) → ids.order.toList = image.cellIds

Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.TxIndex → List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord → Prop := fun txs records => ∀ (transactionId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId), txs[transactionId]? = Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.firstIndex records transactionId

∀ {txs : Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.TxIndex} {records : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord}, txs.Exact records → ∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord), (txs.admitAt records.length record).Exact (records ++ [record])

∀ {txs : Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.TxIndex} {records : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord}, txs.Exact records → ∀ (more : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord), (txs.extendFrom records.length more).Exact (records ++ more)

∀ {txs : Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.TxIndex} {records : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord}, txs.Exact records → ∀ (transactionId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId), txs[transactionId]? = List.findIdx? (fun record => record.transactionId == transactionId) records
∀ (raw : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId) (id : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId), (raw ++ [id]).eraseDups = raw.eraseDups ++ if id ∈ raw then [] else [id]

∀ (records : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord) (record : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord) (transactionId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId), Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.firstIndex (records ++ [record]) transactionId = (Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.firstIndex records transactionId).or (if (record.transactionId == transactionId) = Bool.true then Option.some records.length else Option.none)

∀ (image : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.Image) (record : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord), Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.rawIds { seed := image.seed, accepted := image.accepted ++ [record] } = Minidregg.Kernel.SessionIndex.rawIds image ++ List.map Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite.cellId record.writes
